reason: My exam is close and I freeze when I speak, so I'd use the 7 free days, and if my scores actually go up I'd pay for one month of Pro and cancel right after the test. I wouldn't take the yearly plan, I only need it for a few weeks.
objection: $4.99 in dollars through the App Store comes out to a noticeable sum in soms for me, and it only fixes pronunciation, but on the real IELTS what matters most to me is fluency and grammar.
would_change_my_mind: If the trial didn't make it obvious that my speech sounds better, or if it charged me automatically before I'd decided, I wouldn't pay at all.
